summary.text: Carroll Asseo is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 53, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Jason Blair (R).

paragraphs.text: Carroll Asseo graduated from Lawton High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Cameron University in 1975 and a graduate degree from the University of Oklahoma in 1983.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a native Oklahoman who has lived in Moore for 50 years and recently retired after 42 years in public education, working as a teacher, assistant principal, principal and superintendent, including 13 years as principal of Tinker Elementary.
After retiring she volunteered at the Oklahoma Democratic Party state office and the Cleveland County Democrats office, where she served as secretary for a few years.
Asseo listed her campaign priorities in the survey as public education, affordable living for working Oklahomans and access to affordable health care.
She said education reform is the policy area she is most passionate about.
